|strategy=By [mailto:jbh@spam.dimensional.com Joe Helfrich]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/wattoschancecube.html</ref>

[[Watto]] likes to bet big when he gambles. The problem with betting big is that you can lose big as easily as you can win big.

If [[Watto]] is participating in a battle, play this destiny 5 used interrupt to draw destiny. If it's even, you win and get to add two battle destiny. If it's odd, though, you lose &#150; no matter how many battle destiny you draw this battle, your total is reduced to 0.

Why on [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]] would you ever make such a gamble? Well, if [[Watto]]'s alone, or [[General Solo]]'s about to cancel your battle destiny, you have very little to lose, so a lucky draw can make all of the difference. Beware of cards like [[Rebel Leadership]] and [[Changing The Odds]], however.
|rulings=* Zero is an even number.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Watto%27s%20Chance%20Cube</ref>
* If the destiny is not a whole number (e.g. a card with destiny 0.5), it is neither even nor odd, so no result.
